definitions.explanation: a traditional Japanese bedding set consisting of a mattress spread directly on the floor and a quilt-like comforter

examples.japanese: {和|わ}{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}いて→敷く：00366_shiku⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: To lay out a Japanese futon and sleep.

examples.japanese: うち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和|わ}{布団|ぶとん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧、⟦どちらも→どちらも：08721_dochiramo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: At our house we use both Japanese futons and beds.

examples.japanese: {和|わ}{布団|ぶとん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦フローリング→フローリング：11125_furooringu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Japanese futons are meant to be spread on tatami rooms, but when laying them on hardwood floors, measures against moisture are necessary.

notes:
The term distinguishes traditional Japanese floor bedding from Western-style beds. A {和|わ}{布団|ぶとん} set typically consists of a ⟦{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}→敷き布団：07015_shikibuton⟧ (mattress pad) laid on the floor and a ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧ (comforter) placed on top. When not in use, they are folded and stored in a {押|お}し{入|い}れ (closet), freeing the room for daytime use.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}→敷き布団：07015_shikibuton⟧ — bottom mattress/pad
- ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧ — top comforter/quilt
- ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧ — pillow (traditionally filled with buckwheat hulls)
- ⟦シーツ→シーツ：04499_shiitsu⟧ — fitted sheet

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和|わ}{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ — to spread out a futon
- {和|わ}{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畳|たた}む→畳む：02073_tatamu⟧ — to fold up a futon
- {和|わ}{布団|ぶとん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧ — to air out a futon
- {和|わ}{布団|ぶとん}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ — Japanese futon set

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧ — futon (general term; in Japanese usually means the floor type)
- ⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧ — bed (Western-style, raised frame)
- ⟦{敷|し}き→敷く：00366_shiku⟧パッド — mattress pad (thinner, used as an overlay)
